description: Powódź 2010 is a dataset listed in Geoportal Opole Province, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by mapy.opolskie.pl. The database includes thematic layers on flood flooding 2010, characteristic points, inventory of flood embankments. Coverage: PL. The portal shows the English title as "Flooding 2010" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include flood risk, warunki meteorologiczno-geograficzne, huam health and safety, flood, meteorological geographical features, zagrożenie powodziowe. The listing shows 2010-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-opole.
